mcp.name: ai.com.mcp/linkedin
mcp.description: LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content. Powered by HAPI MCP.

profile_text.body:
LinkedIn is a for-profit company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, United States. Its own site presents it as a professional network with 1 billion members, where users manage a professional identity, build and engage with their network, and access knowledge, insights and opportunities. The site highlights features including Open To Work, which lets members tell recruiters privately or share publicly that they are looking for new opportunities, direct messaging to people they know, and formats such as live videos, stories and newsletters for following discussions in an industry.

The harvested material does not describe any AI products from the company itself, and no products are tracked for it. One MCP server appears under the name ai.com.mcp/linkedin, described as exposing the LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content, and as powered by HAPI MCP.

On the legal side, a count of cases places 264 of them in California. No individual cases are listed.
